reviews.comment: i actually really enjoyed this class. im not a writer but i learned so much and prof was very intentional and caring. i hadnt taken 310 or 311 prior to this, but it was easy to kepp up with. dont wait til the last second to start things. there was 1 thing due per week: rough draft > peer review > final draft. thats repeated for 3 major assignments

Great lecturer and interesting class! I honestly learned so much, and the group discussions were fun. Writing is not my favorite, but the course itself is not too demanding. There's 3 major writing assignment, multiple minor writings, and peer reviews. Expectations are very clear. Follow the rubric and feedback and you''ll get an A.

I was so nervous about taking this writing class, but Dr. Adams was so great. She broke everything down and made writing less scary. She really cares about her students and is happy to help them. There are a lot of assignments, most of which are writing, but she is an easy grader as long as she sees effort.

She is now Professor Gorman instead of Adams, but she is truly the best prof I have ever had. The assignments were all fairly easy, and only one assignment was due a week. She would bake treats for us on days we had to do peer reviews, and lectures were kept short and interesting. Take her 100%! Go to her office hours, too, she remembers faces!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is great. There is a clear guideline to the class and she makes it informative and fun. One assignment due per week (literally not bad at all-- probably a combined 3-4 hours per week). If you meet the criteria she provides, you are set.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Adams did the best with what she was given. This class is online so you don't get to interact with her or the TA unless you go to office hours. This class was a lot of work for a 1 hour class but you don't get a lot of other options as a bio major. Do whatever feedback she gives you because she is the one grading the essay. Do the extra credit
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: 3papers w/ weekly discussion posts & quizzes. Harsh grader for all of them. Papers makeup most of ur grade and other 2 hardly make a dent. Rough drafts arent graded; u can only rely on feedback after submission. Forget seeing TAs, just go to her every time since she grades them. Feedback changes everytime. Hardly any examples/papers for assignments

Don't take BIOL 402 if you're not already a good writer (most bio students are NOT). This class is deceptively difficult; do not take this over the summer because it is not enough time for revisions if you have other things going on during the summer. I'd recommend trying a different professor/course if you struggle with writing papers.
